notes: This manifest describes the adapter subset, not everything the research engine can do.
Only normalized lengths, degrees, and a positive, negative, or either-direction full cyclic input in a right-handed XY frame.
Fixed-only and optimized-only ground requests are rejected; hybrid with one fixed seed is supported.
Identical per-target position tolerances are combined with the global point ceiling using the stricter value.
Only soft worst-target transmission goals and report-only compactness requests are supported.
Custom bounds, objective weights, timing, budgets and unsupported output options are rejected.
No validation level above kinematic_candidate is accepted, and a prepared plan is not a validated mechanism.
Fixed representative reservation is disabled so rejected reference designs cannot bypass selected eligibility.
Three planar target orientations: tool frame at P with directed +x parallel to coupler A-to-B in world XY; default 5 degree tolerance per target, individually configurable.
Orientation is constrained only at the same three selected target phases; no mounting-angle variable, intermediate orientation path, timing or dwell.

Pose tasks attempt 4096 nominal and 65536 angular-tolerance dyad samples by default, each bounded at 262144; each branch retains up to six seeds and their refined children. Budgets are configurable, including zero to disable a branch.

Optional rectangular panel screening includes fixed pivots, link centrelines and a rectangular carrier centred on P, width along A-to-B. Checks sample the complete crank turn before seed truncation and at final qualification. No continuous containment, collision, thickness or manufacturing guarantee.
